public_launch_requirement: Counsel-approved named vendor list with DPA links, regions, and transfer terms.

subprocessors.name: Supabase
subprocessors.category: database, auth, storage, and edge APIs
subprocessors.customer_data: workspace records, user identity, auth sessions, assets, receipts, and audit evidence
subprocessors.enabled_when: always required for hosted Startup Office

subprocessors.name: OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible model provider
subprocessors.customer_data: task-specific workspace context, prompts, retrieved citations, and generated drafts

subprocessors.name: Resend
subprocessors.customer_data: recipient email, notification subject, approval/failure summary, and delivery metadata

subprocessors.name: GitHub Actions
subprocessors.customer_data: redacted aggregate worker, monitor, and deploy logs
subprocessors.enabled_when: repository workflows run loop worker, outbox worker, ops monitor, or synthetic monitor

subprocessors.name: Host provider
subprocessors.customer_data: HTTP metadata, app logs, and hosted API traffic

subprocessors.name: Billing or agreement provider
subprocessors.category: manual billing, invoice, payment, or signed agreement evidence
subprocessors.customer_data: company billing status, signed agreement URL, invoice reference, or payment reference
subprocessors.enabled_when: paid beta or commercial evidence is recorded

model_provider_controls: Production preflight rejects fake or disabled AI providers.
Model calls should minimize workspace context to the current task.
Run metadata records provider, model, token usage, cost, and redacted fallback attempts.
AI output remains draft-only until founder approval or explicit human review.
